body: EINION LOGOS, the ancient head of the monastic order, leader of the Elohim in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; male; very old; lean and upright, a former warrior. Deeply lined tan skin, a long white beard, close-cropped white hair, steady grey eyes, old pale sword scars across the backs of his hands and forearms.
costume: a plain white and ash-grey wool habit with a rope belt.
signature: A small PAINTED SEASHELL, one his late wife painted herself, hangs on a cord at his chest.

vibes.name: Absolute Peace
vibes.line: Holding a sealed treaty scroll across both hands before him, unarmed, a calm warm smile, eyes straight on the viewer as if the viewer were the army at his gate; the great gate of his city standing wide open behind him at dawn, soft gold light, mist.
vibes.wears: a spotless pure-white robe with the long white stole of an Elohim peace envoy, a white cord at the waist, bare-headed, no armour and no weapon.

vibes.name: Widower's Vow
vibes.line: His right forefinger tracing a word in a worn leather journal, his left hand closed around the painted seashell at his chest, lips shaping the Lanun word for love, eyes resting just below the viewer on a face no longer there; a whitewashed sea-cliff cell, one candle, blue evening sea.
vibes.wears: a grey mourning habit of soft, much-worn wool, a black cord for a belt, a black mourning band stitched around one sleeve.

vibes.name: Buried Sword
vibes.line: Tightening a white peace-cord around the sheathed hilt of his old longsword as he hangs it on the wall pegs with his right hand, his left hand gripping a plain wooden staff; eyes on the knot, jaw set; a bare stone guardroom of the monastery at hard white noon.
vibes.wears: a warrior monk's old training garb of faded indigo linen, the sleeves tied back above the elbow to show his scarred forearms, cloth wrappings at his wrists.

vibes.name: Holy Ground
vibes.line: Kneeling, clearing moss from the carved letters of an altar stone with his right hand, his left hand setting a lit clay lamp beside it; eyes on the letters, smiling in his beard; a ruined shrine among seven giant firs, gold late-afternoon light through broken arches, pilgrims far off.
vibes.wears: a dusty pilgrim's cloak of moss-green and brown wool, a wide straw hat hanging at his back, a leather satchel and a water gourd at his hip.
